name: Terraform MCP
tagline: Manage Terraform state, plans, and applies from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official Terraform MCP server, by HashiCorp. List workspaces, run plans, inspect state, format HCL files, validate configurations, and trigger applies. The canonical way to give an agent access to your infra-as-code.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Terraform MCP server, by HashiCorp. Exposes the Terraform CLI and Cloud API as MCP tools: list workspaces, run `terraform plan`, format HCL, validate configs, inspect state (with sensitive value redaction), and trigger applies (with confirmation requirements).

## Why we recommend it

If you use Terraform (or OpenTofu) to manage your infrastructure, this is the cleanest way to let your agent help. It can format and validate configs, run plans and show you what would change, and (with proper guardrails) trigger applies. The state is read by default; writes require explicit confirmation.

## When to use it

- Plan review: agent runs `terraform plan` and explains what would change
- Drift detection: agent compares live infra to the state file
- Refactoring help: agent suggests HCL improvements and rewrites
- Cost analysis: agent estimates monthly cost from the plan output
installInstructions:
1. Install Terraform: https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/install
2. Set: `TERRAFORM_CLOUD_TOKEN` (if using Terraform Cloud) or `TERRAFORM_CONFIG_FILE` (for local)
3. `uvx terraform-mcp-server`

**Security note:** `terraform apply` is powerful. Always require human approval before apply runs.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Terraform is open source. Terraform Cloud has a free tier for small teams.
